title: Turquoise Turtle
meta_description: Located in the charming enclave of Seacrest Beach, both tech and luxury lovers will find their ideal vacation home in the Turquoise Turtle! Just 2 miles from Rosemary Beach, residents and vacationers alike enjoy the 12,000-gallon community pool.
description_expanded: DescriptionLocated in the charming enclave of Seacrest Beach, both tech and luxury lovers will find their ideal vacation home in the Turquoise Turtle! Just 2 miles from Rosemary Beach, residents and vacationers alike enjoy the 12,000-gallon community pool and the close proximity of the sugar sand Gulf beach in Seacrest. Be sure to visit the community center, The Village of South Walton Beach, where you’ll enjoy charming shops and delicious restaurants.Those looking for quality and creature comforts will feel pampered with the on-point design trends throughout the home. Originally conceived as a part-time residence, Turquoise Turtle is furnished to an elegant standard not commonly seen in vacation homes.With 4 bedroom suites, Turquoise Turtle is a perfect choice for multiple couples or multi-generational families traveling together, with each enjoying the privacy of their own space. Natural light is abundant throughout, offering the feeling of bringing the outside in. And speaking of outside, multiple decks offer a quiet respite to enjoy a few pages in your book, a beverage or perhaps just the morning sun on your face. The gas grill brings everyone together for the time-honored tradition of the family barbecue.The family gourmet will be thrilled to see the spacious, state-of-the-art kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, quartz counters, and a flirty tile backsplash. The center island is both beautiful and functional, with elegant pendant lights and seating for 4.HOME HIGHLIGHTS* Tram Service to and from the Beach* 4 Free Beach Cruiser Bikes* 4K HDTV, Sonos Sound System, Apple TV, Cable, Harmony Elite Remote to Control it all* 4 Fully Furnished Bedroom Suites* Fully Furnished Decks w/Grill* Close to Seacrest Beach pool and beach* Part of 30ALV Complete Clean Bedding ProgramFIRST FLOORFurnished, covered front porchWide plank wood floors and shiplap wallsOpen concept living areaAbundant natural light throughoutLiving room with seating for 5, HDTV, ceiling fan and soft recessed lightingLarge gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, quartz counters, tile backsplash and center island with pendant lighting and seating for 4Formal dining space with cushioned seating for 8MASTER BEDROOM SUITE with king bed, triple dresser, ceiling fan, and HDTV, private bathSECOND FLOORMASTER BEDROOM SUITE with king bed, dual nightstands, ceiling fan, private deck accessGUEST BEDROOM SUITE with queen bed, ceiling fan and private deck accessBUNK BEDROOM SUITE with 2 twin size bunk beds, ceiling fan, dresser and HDTVDeck with gas grill and seating for 5Laundry room
